name: content-ledger
description: Use the active Workspace Content Ledger as the durable source for content identities, reservations, lifecycle events, evidence, and duplicate prevention.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the active Workspace has the Content Ledger installed and the request requires reading, querying, reserving, changing, reconciling, or relying on content identities, duplicate prevention, production state, approval, publication, delivery, lifecycle events, or content-ledger evidence, regardless of language
